cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.97%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.13%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.
